# Generated files — do not hand-edit

`lib/supabase/types.ts` is generated from the database schema by the Supabase CLI (`supabase gen types`). Never edit it by hand, and ignore it when reviewing diffs — it is a build artifact, not a source. To change these types, change the schema/migrations and regenerate.
